---
title: "Interactive Tools & Calculators"
description: "Interactive tools and calculators from Jeppe Rich's transport research at DTU."
subtitle: "Browser-based transport demand, elasticity, and welfare models"
toc: false
---

These interactive tools run **100% client-side in your browser** (compiled JavaScript engines with pre-calibrated aggregate parameters). No data leaves your browser, and underlying restricted micro-data pipelines (such as raw TU travel survey tabulations) remain isolated in private project repositories.

```{=html}
<div class="card-grid">

  <div class="jr-card">
    <div>
      <div class="jr-card-meta">Transport demand &amp; welfare · Denmark (2023 baseline) · BETA</div>
      <h3><a href="elasticity/index.qmd">Transport Elasticity Calculator Denmark (BETA)</a></h3>
      <p>
        A fast, calibrated Nested Logit / Multinomial Logit surrogate of the Danish National Transport Model (LTM 2.3, Rich 2022), rebased to 2023 with Danish National Travel Survey (TU 0624v1), TERESA 6.21 value-of-time, and TØE 2.2 unit cost data. Available in Danish and English.
      </p>
      <p>
        Evaluate uniform or differentiated changes in <strong>car driving cost</strong>, <strong>car travel time</strong>, <strong>public transport fares</strong>, <strong>public transport travel time</strong>, and <strong>annual car ownership cost</strong> across trip purposes, distance bands, income quintiles, and household car-ownership segments.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="badge-row">
      <a href="elasticity/index.qmd" class="jr-badge badge-tool">🚀 Open Calculator &amp; Documentation</a>
      <a href="elasticity/app/index.html" class="jr-badge badge-pdf" target="_blank">⤢ Launch Full-Window App</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="jr-card">
    <div>
      <div class="jr-card-meta">Electric-car fleet forecast · Denmark · BETA · updated monthly</div>
      <h3><a href="ev-fleet/index.qmd">EV Adaptation model Denmark (BETA)</a></h3>
      <p>
        Counts the battery-electric cars in the Danish car fleet and forecasts when it reaches one million, when electric cars outnumber petrol cars, and the fleet composition to 2040. A small Bayesian stock-flow model is refitted automatically every month from Statistics Denmark data. Available in Danish and English.
      </p>
      <p>
        Also shows the <strong>car tax revenue</strong> the state does not collect because electric cars replace petrol cars, and the <strong>CO2 saved</strong>, with adjustable assumptions.
      </p>
    </div>
    <div class="badge-row">
      <a href="ev-fleet/index.qmd" class="jr-badge badge-tool">🚗 Open the EV Adaptation model</a>
      <a href="ev-fleet/app/methods.pdf" class="jr-badge badge-pdf" target="_blank">📄 Methods note (PDF)</a>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```
